description: (0.5.0) Event-receipt issuance and verification (RFC-ACDP-0017 §10, amending RFC-ACDP-0013). Registry-side for lifecycle+receipts registries at acdp_version >= 0.5.0; consumer-side for acdp-consumer-chain.

expected.behavior: After both appends, registry_state.event_receipts has exactly two elements, index 0 and 1, each event_hash = sha256(JCS(event incl. signature)), accepted_at non-decreasing and >= body.created_at, signed under the receipt key with receipt_type acdp-event-receipt/1.
Retrying e1 byte-identically returns HTTP 200 with the same single receipt for e1; no third receipt is minted.
A receipt whose index is 1 sits at position 0: it fails §10.3 step 5 and is treated as absent; the event has no evidence time.
event_hash computed without the event's signature member: fails step 6, treated as absent.
accepted_at[1] < accepted_at[0]: step 8 fails; retraction is invalid in both passes; node verdict unknown.
registry_did names a different authority than origin_registry: fails step 2, treated as absent.

notes: Behavioral in this Draft: the verifier builds the described bundle from real signed bodies (or the rcpt-001 / sig-003 test keys), runs verify_chain, and asserts the pinned stage values and verdicts. Pinned verdict digests replace these assertions at promotion (RFC-ACDP-0017 §14).
